Dhunche temple has 6 injured people and the car seats 4, so it needs two round trips of 26 minutes each (52 minutes in total). That is far cheaper than deferring 2 injured people at 80 each (160).

The Myagang care home elder cannot be reached. Its only road, to Likhu market, is damaged, so that person is deferred at a cost of 50.

load car1 injured 2

</plan>
